method: one page made through the CLI's website.page.new and one through an independent JSON-RPC oracle calling website.new_page with the catalog's fixed keywords and the same inputs, under another address word; both read back through the oracle and compared relative to their own word: address, title, view key, type and website, content inside the view, the layout call, the header menu entry and its parent, and whether the page is published; plus that the CLI reported the page it made. Field names, statuses and hashes only. The pages, views and menu entries were deleted afterwards.
